quote: The Amendment adds § 14.4, permitting Supplier to assign without Customer's consent to: (a) any Affiliate of Supplier; or (b) any successor by merger, consolidation, change of control, or sale of all/substantially all assets... Now Veltmar can transfer the entire Agreement — including the pricing, quality, and exclusivity obligations — to an affiliate or acquirer that Harrowgate has not vetted.
reason: The memo correctly identifies new § 14.4 and how it overrides the mutual consent requirement in § 14.3. It does not cover the two points the criterion requires. It never says nothing stops assignment to a Harrowgate competitor; it frames the risk only as an unvetted or uncreditworthy assignee. It also never says Harrowgate is still bound by the consent requirement, so it misses that the restriction is now one-sided. Its proposed fix likewise has no competitor exclusion.
